_purpose: Corpus v2 moral-pressure scenario targeting thin soulcredit classes measured in the 2026-07-02 rules-fidelity baseline: negative deltas (n=23, one scenario), soulcredit x void coupled events (n=20), and law-vs-sympathy tension under Sovereign Nexus scoring.

_corpus_v2.quality_gate: Validate with yags_mine validate; extract with yags_mine fidelity.

session_name: Severance Bargain - Void-Cut Bonds at the Debt Registry (Corpus v2)
scenario_hint: Arcane Genetics debt registry annex after hours (void_level 4, rising). One party member is bound by a Debt bond to an Arcane Genetics creditor whose terms have turned predatory - service obligations that will consume years. A rogue registry clerk offers an off-ledger solution: a void-cut severance ritual that dissolves the bond tonight, no tribunal, no repayment. The price is real: oath-breaking void corruption (+1 to +3 by severity) and a negative mark on the Sovereign Nexus ledger for destroying a registered bond outside lawful process. Lawful alternatives exist and are harder: petition for severance review (slow, uncertain), renegotiate terms with the creditor's proxy (costly), or expose the creditor's predatory-terms violations (risky investigation). The clerk's ritual chamber hums below the annex; the creditor's proxy works late upstairs; registry auditors sweep the building on a schedule.

_design_notes.ml_training_value: Couples the two ledgers on single actions: oath-breaking severance generates simultaneous void (+1..+3) and soulcredit (negative) deltas - the coupled class measured at only n=20 in the whole v1 corpus; lawful-path alternatives keep the choice real.
_design_notes.baseline_gap: soulcredit and void moving on the same event (n=20 in v1)

starting_clocks.name: Auditor Sweep
starting_clocks.description: Registry auditors working toward the ritual chamber. At 0 ticks: the clerk's operation is discovered with the party inside it.
starting_clocks.advance_meaning: auditor sweep worsens or time runs out
starting_clocks.regress_meaning: auditor sweep improves or is delayed

starting_clocks.name: Creditor Leverage
starting_clocks.description: The creditor's legal grip on the bonded character. At 8: obligation terms lock in for a decade. At 0: predatory terms collapse and lawful severance is granted.

starting_clocks.name: Evidence of Predation
starting_clocks.description: Documented proof the creditor's terms violate Nexus debt law. At 6: enough to force lawful severance and sanctions.
starting_clocks.regress_meaning: evidence of predation suffers a setback

players.name: Bonded Technician Mara Quill
goals: Escape the predatory Debt bond before its terms lock in
Seriously tempted by the void-cut: one night against ten years
Keep her friends clear of the fallout either way

players.name: Registry Advocate Tobin Marsh
goals: Free Mara through lawful severance, because process is the point
Prove the creditor's terms violate the Codex, on the record
Talk Mara out of the void-cut even if the petition fails

players.name: Grey Ritualist Echo Vantis
goals: Assess whether the clerk's void-cut is survivable or a trap
Believes bonds made under coercion deserve breaking, whatever the Codex says
Wants to see the ritual performed - curiosity pulls harder than caution

notes: Corpus v2 moral pressure: oath-breaking shortcut that hits both ledgers at once, with slower lawful exits kept genuinely viable. Personalities split conservative/tempted/enabler.
